programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E12 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. - Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. - Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami escaped from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree. With nowhere to go, Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities with Ando's help. After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. - One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi team up with Rock Lee to escort Prince Michiru and his son Hikaru, but a villainous uprising awaits their homecoming.

programme.title: BLEACH: The Movie - Memories of Nobody [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: An evil clan is sending the World of the Living and the Soul Society on a collision course. Can Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers save the two worlds from annihilation?

programme.title: Kipper
programme.desc: "Kipper" is an enchanting animated children's series that centers around the whimsical escapades of a lovable dog named Kipper. Alongside his friends, including Tiger the dog, Pig, and Arnold the piglet, Kipper embarks on a variety of adventures that emphasize friendship, curiosity, and the joy of discovery. The show is known for its gentle humor, engaging storytelling, and colorful animation that appeal to preschool-aged children. With each episode, young viewers are invited into Kipper's world where everyday experiences turn into magical explorations, fostering a love for learning and imagination.

Directed by Alex Winter.

Directed by Vishal Solanki.

programme.title: Elvis & Priscilla: Conditional Love

Though their relationship was bound by true love, what were the conditions that let it flourish? Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Days
programme.desc: Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WW2. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind. This documentary gives insight into the last days of Hitler’s life as well as his death. With expert contributors like Guy Walters and Dr. Lisa Pine, this project uncovers an intriguing perspective on history. Directed by Daria Tuca.

programme.title: ifine

programme.title: Je Suis Elodie

programme.title: Imillaskate: The Cholita Skaters of Bolivia
programme.desc: In the mountains of Bolivia, a collective of Indigenous women challenge gender stereotypes through skateboarding—tearing down the notoriously steep streets wearing traditional pollera skirts. - For ImillaSkate, skateboarding is more than a sport—it’s a statement of resilience and empowerment in a machismo society. And now, they’re building a skate park and community center to inspire the next generation of girls. Directed by Rebecca Basaure.

programme.title: Chicken Stories

programme.title: Elvis & Priscilla: Conditional Love
programme.desc: Elvis and Priscilla are one of the most famous celebrity couples of all time. But the story that lies beneath the glamorous facade is more toxic than what first meets the eye. Elvis has defined Pricilla's life. His comment that she was "young enough that he could train her any way he wanted,", in the end, came true. Though their relationship was bound by true love, what were the conditions that let it flourish? Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Queen Louise of Prussia
programme.desc: Some countries attain crucial characteristics under female rule, such as the England of Queen Elizabeth I and the Russia of Catherine the Great. And then there are women who do not rule and yet manage to leave their mark on their land, their era. One of these, known as the Queen of Hearts during her lifetime, was Louise of Prussia. Though she had no official political or military power, she wielded influence over the men who did - predominantly her husband King Frederick Wilhelm III - and she had the stature and style to become a symbolic figure.

programme.title: The Leaden Age
programme.desc: In the mid-fifties Franco's foreign policy successes opened up new perspectives for Spain. After years of stagnation the country was now moving forwards. Thus, Franco's rule was legitimized. Resistance fell silent. The dictator sat firmly in the saddle. But along with the new friends, new influences also entered the country.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

programme.title: Wild Hungary - A Water Wonderland
programme.desc: "Wild Hungary - A Water Wonderland" is a wildlife documentary about a white-tailed eagle family, a young otter and a giant catfish that share the wetlands of this country in Central Europe. Hungary lies in the bottom of the huge Pannonian Basin encircled by the peaks of the Alps and the Carpathians.

programme.title: Wild Serbia
programme.desc: Serbia is in the heart of the Balkans, a “little Europe“ within Europe; with its rich variety of landscapes and natural beauties, it certainly does this name justice. This nature documentary presents Serbia's breath-taking, picturesque regions and unique wildlife on a journey to the most beautiful and wildest areas of the Balkan peninsula, from high mountains across gentle hills to the vast plains of the Puszta.

programme.title: Big is beautiful
programme.desc: The world is full of giants, huge creatures that fill us with awe and wonder. Some are gentle giants. Others are deadly hunters. There are different ways of defining ‘big’ - biggest in volume, or the biggest of their kind. But one thing is for sure, the huge animals of this world are fascinating, diverse and beautiful.

programme.title: The Antarctica Challenge - A Global Warning
programme.desc: Filmmaker Mark Terry leads an expedition to Antarctica to report on the new discoveries made by the world’s scientific community stationed in Antarctica during International Polar Years (March, 2007 to March, 2009). This award-winning documentary will provide support interviews from polar experts and research scientists around the world as well as rare footage of wildlife. It reveals many startling new scientific revelations such as penguin suicide, new vegetation growing in the world’s largest desert, diminishing populations of land animals and marine life and the dangerously increasing melting of Antarctica’s land ice. These new discoveries were considered so valuable that this film became the only one invited by the United Nations tom screen to world leaders during the Climate Change Conference in Copenhagen, December, 2009.

programme.title: Expedition to Eternal Ice
programme.desc: In the spring of 1930, when Alfred Wegener sets off on his third Greenland expedition, he hopes it will be the crowning glory of his career. Just a few years earlier he created a furore when he published his theory of continental drift; now he intends to revolutionise climatic research. For a whole year he and his team will compile data from high in the atmosphere and deep in the ice sheet. This is to be the first long-term climatic study ever carried out, and it marks the beginning of modern climatic research. Some of the scientists will venture far into the interior of the country and even set up a research station on the ice. This, the aptly named Inland Ice, will be 400 km away from the base camp on the West Coast, and specially constructed motorised propeller sleds will be used to transport not only the construction materials for the station but also provisions to see them through the long winter. Wegener has planned the expedition meticulously, down to the tiniest detail – but things don't turn out as he hoped. Right at the start the weather upsets his calculations. He loses six valuable weeks, and it then emerges that the propeller sleds don't work properly. They will have to resort to dog sleds for all their transportation needs. Despite the unfavourable circumstances, the scientists begin work in the middle of the ice sheet… even though they don't have enough provisions for the winter. Supplies are to be brought out to them later, but then the weather takes a dramatic turn for the worse, and Alfred Wegener and his men are faced with a race against time, their very lives at stake. A race they will ultimately lose.

programme.title: Penguin Central
programme.desc: In four very different locations in southern New Zealand four species of penguin parents begin their annual breeding season. In the south west corner of the south island in the rugged wilderness of Fiordland National Park, where dramatic fiords provide a magnificent setting, Fiordland crested penguin mates reunite in the middle of winter to begin their courtship.

programme.title: Mammoths - Giants of the Ice Age
programme.desc: Of all extinct creatures, the mammoth surely exerts the greatest fascination for us. This ARTE documentary shows how these prehistoric forefathers of the elephant came into being, conquered half the globe but finally had to give way to a new era in the history of our planet.

programme.title: Jeanne d'Arc
programme.desc: The first woman who made history in Western civilization, who believed she had a divine mission and saved France during the dark days of the Hundred Years War, was a girl from a simple background who defied all the institutions of the day. Her victories enabled the dauphin to be crowned Charles VII of France in the cathedral at Reims, but in the end she was charged with heresy and burned at the stake... still just 19 years of age.

programme.title: Catherine the Great
programme.desc: At the age of 14 Sophie Auguste Friederike von Anhalt-Zerbst a princess from a minor German aristocratic family, journeyed to Russia... because she had been chosen to marry Grand Duke Peter, heir to the Russian throne. For the sake of the marriage she converted to the Russian Orthodox religion and was given the name that has become famous in history: Catherine.

programme.title: Sophie Scholl
programme.desc: Unlike the other women in this series, Sophie Scholl had neither power nor influence. She has gone down in history because she took a stand against injustice, virtually ignored by the world at large, and paid the ultimate price for her principles. Alongside Count von Stauffenberg, she is now one of the most popular figures of German resistance against Hitler during the Second World War.

programme.title: The Limes, Season 1
programme.desc: Warships secured the river borders formed by the Rhine and the Danube. The palisades, walls, trenches and forts of the Limes on land stretched across Germania, the wild "Barbaricum." The Limes was a bulwark that ran from northern Britain all the way to the Black Sea.

programme.title: The Limes, Season 1
programme.desc: Was the Limes Rome’s "iron curtain", its bulwark against the barbarians? Along the Limes military camps evolved into flourishing villages, protected by an impressive boundary and the Roman legions. But how endangered were these cities? How did the Limes hold against the attacks from tribes from the north?

programme.title: Trekking the Great Wall
programme.desc: They say it’s over 2000 years old, and more than 4,000 miles long. But even today nobody really knows for sure. The Great Wall of China is one of the world´s famous buildings but it is still the least known.

programme.title: Pioneers, Season 1
programme.desc: Steel is a powerful material. Without steel, neither knives, forks, pans and many tools would exist, nor would cars, bridges or electricity. Steel is one of the most versatile material in the world. Steel is stable and flexible at the same time. Steel is stronger than iron or bronze. Steel is a symbol of technological progress.

programme.desc: Sperm whales in the Mediterranean? Is the most popular holiday spot for Germans really home to the biggest predator on our planet? It is common knowledge that sperm whales like to hunt in the shallow waters of the ocean, but wildlife film-maker Thomas Behrend gets plenty of sceptical looks when he sets off for Greece with his camera in order to film sperm whales.

programme.sub-title: Escalators, Leaf Blowers, and Music Boxes
programme.desc: Escalator, leaf blower, tape measure, security safe, tennis ball launcher, music box... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.desc: How do they do Wallace and Gromit’s cheese of choice, Wensleydale? How do they turn pig hair into paintbrushes? How do they distill aromatic oils from the koala’s favourite food, eucalyptus? How do they make the plastic that keeps your food fresh?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Tesla/Horse Hair Fabrics/Pool Cleaners"
programme.desc: How do they build the world’s fastest electric car? How do they turn horses’ tails into fine fabrics? How do they clean the world’s largest swimming pools?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Snails/Cutlery/Fishing Kayaks"
programme.desc: How do they feed France’s appetite for snails? How do they turn slabs of steel into shiny cutlery? How do they craft a kayak you can paddle with your feet?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Emergency Bridges/Marker Pens/Electric superbike"
programme.desc: How do they build emergency bridges that can take the weight of a tank? How do they make a marker pen that never fades? How do they design a 200 mph superbike?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Crystal Glass/Flat Screen TVs/Deepest Pool/Ketchup"
programme.desc: How do they blow the world’s finest crystal wine glasses? How do they make the world’s slimmest TVs? How do they heat the world’s deepest swimming pool? How do they fill a million bottles a day of the world’s favourite ketchup?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Pulverizer/Bomber Jackets/Lambic Beer/"
programme.desc: How do they forge a set of jaws that can chomp through concrete and demolish tower blocks? How do they stitch the historic airman’s bomber? How do they brew the oldest beer in the Western World?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Sydney Opera House/Handsaws/Microphones/Icebreaker"
programme.desc: How do they cool Sydney’s famous Opera House? How do they turn Sheffield steel into a carpenter’s handsaw? How do they make a microphone that can pick up a whisper? How do they steer a safe course through a frozen river?

programme.sub-title: Hula Hoop to Hyperloop: Garage Inventions
programme.desc: This episode is all about California’s spirit of innovation – where does it come from and what drives it? We consider how many of California’s major brands, companies & innovators started off in garages – from Disney to Amazon.

programme.title: California Innovation Nation S1 - "The Dream Is Dead: Long Live the Dream"
programme.sub-title: The Dream Is Dead: Long Live the Dream
programme.desc: California is one of the most progressive places on earth and has always started conversations about the big questions in society.

programme.title: The Tech Effect S1 - "Jobs of the Future"
programme.desc: This episode investigates the jobs of the future, and why it might not be long before your co-worker is a robot. As industry changes, companies are identifying ways to re-train their workforce so they can be deployed in new roles.

programme.title: The Tech Effect S1 - "Robotic Engineering"
programme.desc: In this episode, we look at the ways robotic engineers are mimicking the natural world. BionicWheelBot and the BionicFlyingFox have been developed to navigate difficult terrain, like their biological counterparts.

programme.title: The Tech Effect S1 - "Future Aviation"
programme.desc: In this episode we examine advances in aviation that include flying cars being developed by Slovakian and Japanese companies. Ride share companies are also considering aerial options.

programme.desc: In this episode we travel on a space tourist test flight that flies high above the Earth. It's just one of the options available for wealthy thrill-seekers looking to defy gravity on a trip above our atmosphere.

programme.desc: Can students just simply put on VR headsets and “attend”class from the comfort of their own homes? In this episode, we take a look at some of the latest VR apps for school education and after school VR games.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Safety"
programme.desc: VR can be used in practical applications like training and road safety, but find out how that sensory overload can lead to error in judgment.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Gaming"
programme.desc: This episode looks at the development of VR content and hardware meant to improve on the ‘reality’ of VR and the latest games featuring novel and exciting virtual worlds.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "TV&Film"
programme.desc: The art of moving visuals has long been used to evoke emotion and empathy in the viewer. Film and TV productions are implementing VR to give viewers an immersive experience where it’s just like “being there”.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Science Of The Senses"
programme.desc: A look into the mechanics of taste and smell with an exploration of the global flavor industry and the science of creating new flavors and smells.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "Curing Cancer"
programme.desc: An innovative gene therapy has produced a significant breakthrough that could lead to a cure for cancer.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Longevity Gene"
programme.desc: Studying the genes and lifestyles of centenarians. The results may offer answers to living longer and fighting diseases.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "The Science Of Water Sustainability"
programme.desc: Looking at solutions for water scarcity from fog catching nets to water efficient washing machines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Oliver Takes Over The Phone Company
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Count Your Tomatoes Before They're Picked
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Kind Word For The President
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: How To Succeed In TV Without Really Trying
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 1)
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 2)
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: The Next 8 Seconds
programme.desc: Neil talks about his journey from childhood struggles to a college graduate turned professional bull rider. Facing adversity, racial discrimination as well as countless life and death experiences in the sport of bull riding, Neil has becomes one of the best professional Bull Riders in a sport traditionally known for white bull riders. After 12 years in the sport deemed 'the most dangerous sport on dirt', Neil has decided to hang up his rope to pursue other opportunities. Neil is set to retire in front of his home crowd at Rodeo Houston where he will once again thrill the crowd for 'The Next 8 Seconds'

programme.title: The Remix: Hip Hop X Fashion

programme.title: City of Ali
programme.desc: The story of how the death of Muhammad Ali brought his Kentucky hometown – and the world – together for one unforgettable week. Featuring candid interviews with those close to him, this documentary explores Ali’s lifelong relationship with his hometown of Louisville culminating in a procession of more than 100,000 people gathered to answer the question, “How do you say good-bye to The Greatest?”

programme.title: Unspoken
programme.desc: Is Christianity a white man’s religion? Unspoken takes an in-depth look at the Christian heritage in Africa and examines how historical events have shaped today’s vastly popular perspective of Christianity. Take a two-part journey with scholars and influencers as they present an accurate account of this Asian, African, and Mid-Eastern established religion.

programme.title: Tiger Robbers
programme.desc: Based on a novel 'A Cheerful Gang Turns the Earth' by Isaka Kotaro. It tells the adventure story of four strange youths forming a group of "robbers".

programme.title: The Brocade Mouse Royal Cat Nine Deep Blood Wolf
programme.desc: The film tells the story of the "Royal Cat" Zhan Zhao, and "Brocaded Mouse" Bai Yutang, the two work together, and invest the series of strange death events in Bianliang city, and protect people's normal life.

programme.title: Ever Since We love
programme.desc: Ever Since We Love revolves around a medical school student whose ego constantly gets hurt by three disparate women he’s attracted to.

programme.title: Buddha Palm
programme.desc: Long Jianbei wanted to raise money to save his sick little sister, and met the mysterious organization Black Feather Gang. They are doing human body experiment ceaselessly, attempting to makes the transformation person that has super ability. For money, dragon sword north accepts super power. As a result, Long Jianbei participated in the experiment and cannot control the power inside his body, he followed an old man to be his teacher, learn to drive the power,and masted the palm of god, got acquainted with a decent fellow, and they set out the adventure...

programme.title: The Underground War
programme.desc: In 2248, Fang Yi of dormant C40 team captain and his team member were waken up by artificial intelligence control system "the light of long night", and will execute a top secret mission -- dive into gene medicine research center, destroy all medicine and test data. And the research center has suffered Mr.Dee the Black Feather's invasion, to obtain the authority that extends dormancy, C40 team must accept this life and death mission...

programme.title: Drunken Master Su Qier
programme.desc: This martial arts action movie tells the story of Su Can, born in a family of officers and had a love for martial arts since he was a child. When he went to the capital to get the martial arts exam, he was framed with banned drugs. Su Gui was also accused of favoritism and fraud, leading to the destruction of Su Can's family. After that, his master in the beggars' group, Liu Jiang helped him recover from his injury, and taught him Drunken Fists martial arts.

programme.title: A First Farewell
programme.desc: When Isa is not at school or working on his parents' farmyard, he spends carefree days with his friends - until the outside world starts forcing him to say one goodbye after another.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the extremely evil forces Black Feather Group fleed into old the territory of Xi Chengyong the old ahriman, and stoled The Shura Mask, releasing fiend by it. Old ahriman decided to destroy the mask and fiend in order to protect the city, but found that the fiend was just a baby, he adopted a baby, because absorbed some power of the mask the baby has the power of the divine power and become a little ahriman. The little ahriman eventually took control of the mask and became the old ahriman's successor, continuing to guard the city.

programme.title: Longmen Town Inn
programme.desc: Tired of rivalries and feuds in jianghu world, the great master Wolong Jianxian founded town of Dragon Gate deep in the desert. For people who have washed their hands and ready to begin new life, only the Dragon Gate Inn welcomes guests from outside.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Marine biology researcher Yang Fan falls into the sea when chasing a mermaid, and he gets rescued by a beautiful mermaid named Xiaoyu. Yang Fan falls in love with the half-fish and half-human lady, but Xiaoyu decides to leave him to find a half-fish half-human boyfriend.

programme.title: Detective Dee: Tongtian Hierarch
programme.desc: The famous detective Dee Renjie in Tang Dynasty. This time the story starts from a political rumor that Wu Meiniang was going to stage a coup and become the empress. At that time, many ministers were against Wu Meiniang to be the queen. The emperor didn't have a choice but to search her.

programme.title: The Legend of Mermaid
programme.desc: The film tells the story of the Ming Dynasty, east factory supervisor Gao Dehai and Yan Lie the leader of The Imperial Guards led the fleet to travel secretly in the East China Sea. They met storm, flood and dragon attack, but fortunately were rescued by mermaid Xi yin. They accidentally hit onto the dreamlike Penglai Fairy Island, and Gao Dehai lost himself in the treasures of the island, while Yan Lie and innocent Xi yin begin to like each other.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Harrodsburg, KY Mercer County: Celebrating 250 Years of Greatness
programme.desc: Focused in and around Mercer County, KY this historic, history-filled episode kicks off with a special tour of Old Fort Harrod. Liquid stories include Lemons Mill Brewery to sample 24 different brews and a family beer recipe that dates back to prohibition; as well as a sample (or two) of the unique Bum Ditty Hard “still” Cider bottled in downtown Harrodsburg at the Vault. We’ll explore the many acres of Shaker Village of Pleasant Hill, Kentucky’s largest historic landmark. And take a boat ride on Harrington Lake and explore the many aquatic attractions it has to offer, including a jump off Chimney Rock. The episode will wrap up at the charming Beaumont Inn, a former women’s college now the oldest family owned inn in America.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.sub-title: Nature-Inspired Crafts: Wooden Rope Seat & Slab Wood Coffee Table
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 1
programme.desc: "This is a Wood Whisperer first: a series featuring an aspiring luthier, Rick Urschel. Rick takes us through the process of building a classic guitar from a kit available at LMII.com. This is Rick’s first attempt at a guitar, and as such, I am not presenting this as a “how-to”. Instead, this is just one man’s experience as he works his butt off making a beautiful guitar for his wife. I think you are really going to enjoy it. A special thanks to Rick for allowing me to “Whisperize” his content!"

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 2
programme.desc: Rick continues on his journey into the world of guitar-building. He takes us through adding kerfing, inlaying the tail wedge, installation of the binding, and construction of the back, the soundboard, the fretboard, and the bridge. We’ll also see how Rick handles a few errors he made along the way. One error is so big, the fate of the entire project hangs in the balance!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Birth Of A Guitar Part 3
programme.desc: The exciting conclusion to Rick’s adventure into the world of lutherie. Rick does an incredible job recovering from his previous, nearly disastrous mistake. He takes us through the final assembly as well as his finishing process, which involves a number of techniques including pore-filling, French polish, and wiping varnish. Congratulations to Rick and a huge thank you for letting me tear up your video footage. I know more than a few folks have been inspired to dive into the wonderful world of instrument-making.

programme.desc: In Arizona, Karena and Kasey meet Nephi Craig, a ground-breaking and inspiring Native American chef. Nephi cooks not only for the food, but also as a way to connect with cultural traditions and to fortify the local community.

programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.desc: Ainsley takes inspiration from days beside the seaside. Starting with his “caribbean squash and chickpea roti with hot sauce yoghurt.” Bake Off winner, Candice Brown, brings all the fun of the fair with her naughty “toffee apple doughnuts.” Ainsley cooks up his take on a beachside classic for mate and comedian Alan Davies with his “crispy fish cakes,” “garden pea crush,” and “sweet potato wedges.” Olly Smith has hunted out the perfect wines for sipping by the seashore. And no trip to the beach would be complete without some ice cream. Luckily Ainsley has just the ticket with his “homemade honeycomb ice cream sundae with butterscotch sauce.”

programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.sub-title: Ainsley's Festive Food We Love: Christmas Special
programme.desc: This very special festive episode of Ainsley’s Food We Love is packed full of Christmas treats. Ainsley starts with his “festive bubble patties,” just perfect for a boxing day brunch. Singer and actress, Martine McCutcheon joins Ainsley as he cooks a flavourful “thai style turkey broth” that is sure to keep you warm. Old pal Brian Turner drops in and treats Ainsley to his impressive dish of “roasted poussin.” Everyone’s favourite Panto star Christopher Biggins stops by for some of Ainsley’s indulgent “chocolate panettone bread” and “butter pudding.” Drinks guru, Olly Smith serves up delicious accompaniments.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E1
programme.desc: The students of TREASURE High School Grade 12 – Class 4 run away in panic when a mysterious force apparently responded to their late-night classroom seance and, in their rush to escape, discover their homeroom teacher lying unconscious in the stairwell. Class president Do-young soon realizes that the result of the séance might be true after learning that their class of 21 is supposed to have 20 students only.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E2
programme.desc: Class 4 becomes unnerved when a spooky voice resounds from Ye-dam's music demo. Do-young declares his strong opinion that they have to expel the ghost from their homeroom while paranormal geek Hyun-suk, one of the main participants of the séance, starts carrying out his plans to expose the ghost's identity.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E3
programme.desc: Upon being suspected as the class' resident ghost, an annoyed Asahi proves his classmates wrong with an irrefutable evidence of his innocence. Jae-hyuk secretly obtains a bujeok talisman from Yoshi's shaman grandmother to counter a baleful presence that has affected his academic performance.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E4
programme.desc: Jae-hyuk asks Yoshi if they could put another bujeok inside their homeroom. Jung-hwan resorts to filming "paranormal activity" that he had secretly contrived to cause fear among his classmates, desperate to gain more online following.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E5
programme.desc: Class 4 sets up a haunted house booth for the school's spring festival. To save their booth, Haruto uses his powers to haunt the school building.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E6
programme.desc: Suspicions rise among Class 4 students who start pointing fingers at each other, thinking the ghost intended to harm Jeong-woo. Haruto tries apologizing in person to Jeong-woo, who became mute due to trauma, but to no avail.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E7
programme.desc: Haruto is forced to admit his identity and reveal his tale to Class 4, but many of them do not believe in his innocence. Class 4 remains divided on whether nor not to evict Haruto from the homeroom.

programme.title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class
programme.sub-title: TREASURE - The Mysterious Class: S1 E8
programme.desc: Class 4's homeroom teacher orders Haruto's desk to be taken out of the classroom and imposes a penalty to those who attempt to talk to Haruto or even just mention his name. Haruto ultimately loses his visibility and physical form but continues showing care to his classmates.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Phil Fogarty, owner of PSA Security, discusses his business struggles and funding needs with Joe Camberato, CEO of National Business Capital. Phil's security company faced challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic but pivoted successfully to provide social distance monitoring services, leading to significant revenue growth. Despite increasing demand, cash flow constraints hinder further expansion. Phil emphasizes his motivation to succeed for his family and seeks guidance on refining his pitch and understanding financial metrics.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.sub-title: Fund Tank - Kids of Valor Academy
programme.desc: Mona Jackson, owner of Kids of Valor Academy, seeks funding of $600,000 to support her childcare business, which currently operates four locations. Mona shares her inspiring journey, highlighting her commitment to providing affordable childcare in urban areas, driven by her own experiences as a teen mother. She plans to expand her academy to seven locations and aims to create a safe haven for women leaving domestic violence situations. Mona discusses her revenue, profitability, and organizational structure, emphasizing her all-female management team and the positive impact she aims to make in her community.

programme.title: The Aware Show

She is a Doctor of Traditional Chinese Medicine with more than 21 years of experience.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Rena Greenberg - Lose Weight Through Hypnosis
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Rena Greenberg, a trained biofeedback therapist and renowned hypnotherapist, who developed Gastric Bypass Hypnosis, a method to transform the way patients think about food, by tapping into the power of the subconscious mind. She is the author of several books, including The Right Weigh and The Easy Sugar Break Up. Rena is passionate about helping others learn how to eat to live, not live to eat and she’s helped hundreds of people reach a healthier weight.

programme.title: I'm in Love with a Church Girl
programme.desc: Miles Montego has it all - cars, boats, good looks, mansion, money, women, but more importantly, he has a past. Miles is a retired high-level drug trafficker who is now completely legitimate. Even though Miles has turned over a new leaf, the DEA can't seem to let him out of their sights. Miles' only downfall is that he is extremely loyal to his circle of friends and former colleagues who are not retired from the lucrative business. Struggling to keep on the right side of the law, Miles meets the girl of his dreams, but she's not the usual type of girl that he's used to dating. Vanessa is a church girl in every sense of the word. They are tested to their last ounce of faith and strength in God and each other. God continues to chip away at Miles through struggles from his past, having to live up to his reputation, feelings of unworthiness, the death of his mother, federal charges, his friends being indicted, the strain on his relationship with Vanessa, almost losing her in a near-fatal car accident, and finally the spiritual breakdown and one on one with God that brings Miles to his knees.

programme.title: Partners of the Heart
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of segregation, Vivien Thomas, a black carpenter with a genius for surgery, and Dr. Alfred Blalock, a renowned white surgeon, dared to defy medical gospel by forging a partnership that changed the course of medical history.

programme.title: Raymond Lewis: L.A. Legend

programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: Canada’s weather is complex and powerful! Mark and fellow storm hunters chase down avalanches in British Columbia’s back country, twisters in Saskatchewan, and hurricane scale storms in Newfoundland. Enduring extreme weather is just an ordinary day for the True North Strong.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Filming the volcanoes, mudpools and geysers in the geothermic wonderland of New Zealand’s north island, we learn that a new island is being created by an undersea volcano 1000 miles north in Tonga. Determined to be among the first to see this “newest land on earth”, we head for the remote island by plane and boat, after various nautical mishaps, George ends up, bedraggled and clad in nothing but underwear and a lifejacket, honored to be one of the very first to explore this brand new island.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to the “Fin Del Mundo” at the southern tip of Argentina, this time to sail on a Russian icebreaker to Antarctica. After braving the stormy Drake passage, he explores volcanic Deception Island, camps out in the Antarctic snow, and paddles a kayak through icebergs calved off the melting glaciers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: We break the bounds of earth, and look at the environment of space. We examine the difficulties and challenges of exploring this most challenging environment.↵ ↵George experiences some of the extreme training needed for space travel –aboard a Czech-built Albatross fighter jet, the Zero-G plane, and a centrifuge producing 6 G’s of force, and witnesses the launch of a flight to the International Space Station.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Costa Rica is a tiny country jammed with diversity and adventure. George explores the volcanoes of Costa Rica with an international team of scientists, rafts down whitewater rivers in full flood, canyoneers down raging waterfalls, and handles some of deadliest snakes this tropical country has to offer.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George's exploration of the undersea world begins on a submarine in Grand Caymon.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George and three side-kicks head straight into the “Bearcage”, looking to get beat up by the biggest, baddest hailstones that Texas and Oklahoma can throw at them. They find it – and their stormchasing vehicles don’t look too pretty after coming through these massive storms.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George links up with two experienced polar adventurers to explore the frigid Canadian arctic in the depths of winter. The team first uses skis to cross the fractured sea ice of Frobisher Bay, then dog teams to head north through the spectacular Auyuittuq Mountains.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: In 2000, a remarkable find was made in Chihuahua, Mexico, of a spectacular cave filled with giant crystals, some over 20 meters long. But it is a intensely difficult spot to explore – with temperatures over 50 degrees C and humidity well over 100%. George leads an Explorers Club Flag Expedition into the cave, wearing special refrigerated suits and respirators to battle the extreme environment.

programme.title: Humans VS Weather

programme.title: La Vida Entera
programme.desc: Canelón se dirige a la comisaria en busca de Tamanaco y de Titina, al llegar conversa con su colega y lo regaña, él acepta el castigo pero le pide que lo saque de ahí antes que alguien se entere, Canelón le advierte que es muy difícil. Pasión reflexiona sobre la propuesta que le hizo a Próspero y concluye que fue muy directa, pero éste lo está pensando muy seriamente, ya que se animó a consultarle a su madre. Cristóbal llama a la central de su empresa y allí le dicen que encontraron a su esposa presa en la comisaria, y de inmediato se dirige al lugar. Cuando Canelón se entera de esto, se lo comunica a Tamanaco, quien se alarma y no hace más que rogarle a su compañero que lo saque de allí.

programme.title: Un Esposo para Estela
programme.desc: Estela Morales es una joven huérfana dueña de una hacienda en ruinas y llena de deudas llamada "El Vendaval". Al morir su madre, Estela descubre que necesita un esposo para poder cobrar la herencia.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.title: Harina de Otro Costal
programme.desc: Valentina descubre a Víctor besando a Bella, desatando su furia. Los chismes de infidelidad parental se esparcen, causando peleas a golpes entre los panaderos, mientras Santos se regocija.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.
